title: Consume TextFrameProperties: insets, vertical align, auto-size in the type engine
outcome: Text frames honor their validated textFrame contract: insets shrink the measure, verticalAlign positions the composed block, autoSize grows the frame to fit content, and single-column zero-inset frames render pixel-identically to today.
before: Audit confirmed on base 72b05f0 (includes VIRO-0142): every type frame carries textFrame (types.ts:172-181, defaults text-model.ts:23-32), migration stamps it, validation enforces it — but drawTypeFrame composed against raw layer w/h (type.ts:724 pre-change). inset, verticalAlign, autoSize, columns and kind point/path were validated and consumed nowhere. Defaults (zero inset, 1 column, top, none) meant consuming them moves no existing pixels.
after: composeFrame(face, story, w, h, textFrame?) consumes insets (reduced measure + foot, pen starts at the top-left inset, carets follow) and verticalAlign (center/bottom shift the fitted block inside the content box; 'justify' documented fallback to top; overflowing frames stay top-aligned). drawTypeFrame passes layer.textFrame, so the canvas render path honors the contract. measureAutoFit provides read-only autoSize:'height' measurement (height-independent, inset-aware, unbounded-foot). The auto-fit mutation is specified as a reversible bus command but is NOT registered — the commands registry and its parity test are outside this packet's lease (see blocked_scope).
acceptance: Frame with inset 24 composes against the reduced measure, first baseline shifted (screenshot).
verticalAlign: 'center' centers the composed block between frame top/bottom.

autoSize: 'height' grows the frame via a NEW reversible bus command to fit composeFrame height; undo restores. (Sanctioned fallback exercised: command registry src/document/ui-commands.ts + tests/ui-commands.test.mjs are off-lease, so autoSize is delivered as read-only engine measurement + documented command spec.)
Zero-inset single-column documents render pixel-identically (regression, pixel-diff).
Gates: new tests, tsc, test:unit 316/316, build once.
evidence: tests/text-frame-inset.test.mjs: baseline shift, rewrap (5→6 lines at measure 372), no ink inside insets, committed screenshots tests/text-frame-shots/inset-0.png + inset-24.png

tests/text-frame-valign.test.mjs: center/bottom block placement (data + ink-box pixel proof, valign-center.png/valign-bottom.png), caret stops follow the shift, overflow stays top-aligned, 'justify' fallback pinned

tests/text-frame-autosize.test.mjs: measureAutoFit null for none/width/both/absent; height fit swallows overflow at unchanged measure; height-independent; inset-aware (+/- bottom inset exact); fixed point for undo; one line box minimum for empty stories

tests/text-frame-pixel-baseline.test.mjs + tests/text-frame-pixel-baseline.json: raw-RGBA SHA-256 golden captured on the UNMODIFIED engine at base 72b05f0; post-change renders bit-identical for all 6 zero-inset cases incl. no-textFrame vs default-textFrame parity
